summary:
Fix Active Recall Missing Questions & Refine Math Problem Recognition

- Robust Question Prompt Resolution: Support all question field variants (front, frontPrompt, promptQuestion, problemStatement, prompt, question) with intelligent fallback so questions never render blank in Today's Recall session.
- Precision Math Mode: Restrict mathematical calculation input and toolbar strictly to cards with cardType 'math_problem' or explicit numerical computation prompts, preventing standard conceptual cards from being hijacked by number pads.
- Synchronizer Normalization: Update learnDeckSync to ensure all section cards synced into Today's Recall carry valid non-empty front and back strings.
- Concept Check Stability: Ensure Concept Check defaults to standard syllabus rubric checkpoints rather than forcing worked-example fading.
